# Quarterly review of invoice automation

This report summarises what six sites learnt from automating supplier invoices.

## 1. Findings from site 1

The **pipeline** processed *120* supplier invoices this quarter. Key points:

- extraction accuracy rose to 91%
- median handling time fell to 11 minutes
